title: GPU-Accelerated Belief Propagation for Program Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2509.22337v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Belief Propagation (BP) is a widely used approximate inference algorithm in probabilistic graphical models (PGMs), but is computationally expensive when applied to large-scale program analysis. Existing GPU-based approaches are unable to support flexible update strategies and have yet to integrate logical constraints with GPU acceleration, leading to challenges in both generality and efficiency.   We present FastLBP, a GPU-accelerated BP framework for program analysis. We propose a unified representation for specifying flexible update strategies required in program analysis, along with a dependency analysis algorithm to enable parallel execution. Furthermore, we implement BP with local structures on GPUs by assigning individual threads to message computations and utilizing a memory-efficient representation. translated_title: 面向程序分析的GPU加速信念传播
translated_abstract: 信念传播（BP）是概率图模型（PGMs）中广泛使用的近似推理算法，但在应用于大规模程序分析时计算开销十分高昂。现有的基于GPU的方法无法支持灵活的更新策略，也尚未将逻辑约束与GPU加速相结合，导致在通用性和效率方面均面临挑战。我们提出了FastLBP，一个用于程序分析的GPU加速信念传播框架。我们提出了一种统一表示方法来指定程序分析中所需的灵活更新策略，并提出了一种依赖分析算法以实现并行执行。此外，我们通过为消息计算分配独立线程并采用节省内存的表示方式，在GPU上实现了带局部结构的信念传播。在SmartFL和BINGO上的实验表明，FastLBP相比基于CPU的方法分别实现了平均17.42倍和2.82倍的加速。
tldr: FastLBP是一个面向程序分析的GPU加速信念传播框架，通过统一表示灵活更新策略、依赖分析实现并行执行以及内存高效的局部结构实现，相比CPU方法最高取得17.42倍加速。
en_tdlr: FastLBP is a GPU-accelerated belief propagation framework for program analysis that achieves up to 17.42× speedup over CPU-based approaches through unified flexible update strategy representation, dependency analysis for parallel execution, and memory-efficient local structure implementation on GPUs.
